description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu leads state into AI-powered governance era at workshop in Amaravati.
body_lead: Setting the tone for Andhra Pradesh’s digital future, Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on Thursday (April 24, 2025) stated that the State is entering a new era of governance powered by Artificial Intelligence (AI) — one that prioritises smart systems, human-centric solutions, and real-time delivery of services. Mr. Naidu was addressing a workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies for Government Digital Transformation at the Secretariat.
